fieldData.awb---mockup-data: window.awbMockup = { engagementLetters: "Build document automation for my law firm's new clients. A prospective client fills in an intake questionnaire with their name, contact details, matter type and a short description. The answers fill our engagement letter template. If the matter type is litigation, add the $5,000 retainer clause. Send the draft to the responsible attorney for review before it goes out.", salesQuotes: "Build a quote generator for my sales team. When a deal moves to the Proposal stage in HubSpot, copy its line items into our quote template and save the quote as a PDF. Any quote over $25,000 needs approval from the sales director in Slack before the rep can send it.", vendorCertificates: "Build a vendor portal where contractors upload their certificates of insurance. Read the insurer, policy number, expiry date, and per-occurrence limit from each PDF. If the limit is under the $1,000,000 in their contract or the policy has expired, email the vendor asking for an updated certificate and put their job on hold until a valid one is uploaded.", offerLetters: "Build offer letter automation for my company's hiring team. When a candidate moves to Offer in our hiring tracker, fill the offer letter template with the role, start date, manager and base salary. Send it to the hiring manager for approval, then send the candidate a link to sign on their phone." };
